senses.gloss:
[प्लक्ष्यते कीटैः प्लक्ष्-कर्मणि घञ्] 
__1 The Indian figtree; प्लक्षप्ररोह इव सौधतलं विभेद [[R. 8. 93]]; 13. 71; कपित्थैः; किंशुकैः प्लक्षैः [Page1142-2] [[Parṇāl. 4. 62.]] 
__2 One of the seven Dvīpas or continents of the world; प्लक्षो जम्बूप्रमाणो द्वीपः ख्यातिकरो हिरण्मय उत्थितो यत्राग्निरुपास्ते सप्तजिह्वः [[Purāṇam.]] 
__3 A side or back-door, a private entrance. 
__4 The space at the side of a door. 
-Comp. 
-जाता, -समुद्रवाचका an epithet of the river Sarasvatī. 
-तीर्थम्, -प्रस्रवणम्, -राज् m. the place where the Sarasvatī rises. 
-द्वारम् a back-door, a side-entrance; [[Matsya P. 264. 15.]]

a. [प्लु अच्] 
__1 Swimming, floating. 
__2 Jumping, leaping. 3 Ved. Superior, excellent. 
-वः Swimming, floating. 
__2 Flood, swelling of a river. 
__3 A jump, leap; going by leaps or jumps; ते रथैर्देवधिष्ण्याभैर्हयैश्च तरलप्लबैः [[Bhāg. 10. 82. 7.]] 
__4 A raft, float, canoe, small boat; नावश्चारुरुहुस्त्वन्ये प्लवैस्तेरुस्तथापरे [[Rām. 2. 89. 20]] (com. प्लबा वेणुतृणादिनिर्मिताः); नाशयेच्च शनैः पश्चात् प्लवं सलिलपूरवत् [[Pt. 2. 42]]; सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं संतरिष्यसि [[Bg. 4. 36]]; [[Ms. 4. 194]]; 11. 19; [[Ve. 3. 25.]] 
__5 A frog; हंसक्रौञ्चप्लवाकीर्णं सारसैः संप्रसादितम् [[Rām. 3. 35. 18.]] 
__6 A monkey; दधि हृत्बा बकश्चापि प्लवो मत्स्यानसंस्कृतान् [[Mb. 13. 111. 99.]] 
__7 A declivity, slope. 
__8 An enemy. 
__9 A sheep. 
__10 A man of a low tribe, a Chāṇḍāla. 
__11 A net or snare for catching fish. 
__12 The fig-tree. 
__13 The Kāraṇḍava bird, a kind of duck. 
__14 Five or more stanzas syntactically connected ( = कुलक q. v.). 
__15 The prolated utterance of a vowel. 
__16 Returning, return. 
__17 Urging on, inciting. 
__18 Sound; [[L. D. B.]] 
__19 A kind of aquatic bird; [[Ms. 5. 12.]] 
__20 N. of a संवत्सर. 
-Comp. 
-कुम्भः a pitcher used as a support in swimming; स्मरयौवनयोः खलु [Page1143-1] द्वयोः प्लवकुम्भौ भबतः कुचाबुभौ [[N. 2. 31.]] 
-गः 
__1 a monkey; स सेतुं बन्धयामास प्लवगैर्लवणाम्भसि [[R. 12. 70.]] 
__2 a frog. 
__3 an aquatic bird, the diver. 
__4 the शिरीष tree. 
__5 N. of the sun's charioteer. °इन्द्रः Hanumat; [[Bhāg.]] °राजः The monkey chief Sugrīva; राघबप्लवगराजयोरिव प्रेम युक्तमितरेतराश्रयम् [[Ki. 13. 57.]] 
(-गा) the sign of the zodiac called Virqo. 
-गतिः a frog.

[प्लु बाहु° अक] 
__1 A frog. 
__2 A jumper, tumbler, rope-dancer. 
__3 The holy fig-tree. 
__4 A Chāṇḍāla, an outcast. 
__5 A monkey.

__1 An ape, a monkey. 
__2 A deer. 
__3 The fig-tree. 
__4 N. of a संवत्सर.
(In astrol.) The position of a constellation in the quarter ruled by its planetary regent; [[Bṛ. S.]]

__1 A monkey; एवमुक्तस्तु भीमेन स्मितं कृत्वा प्लवङ्गमः [[Mb. 3. 150. 2]]; संचेरुरात्मान इवापरं क्षणात् क्षमारुहं देहमिव प्लबङ्गमाः [[Śi. 12. 55.]] 
__2 A frog. 
-Comp. 
-इन्दुः an epithet of Hanumat.

[प्लु-ल्युट्] a. Inclined, stooping down; प्रागुदक्प्लवनां भूमिं कारयेत् यत्नतो नरः [[Matsya P.]] 
-नम् 
__1 Swimming. 
__2 Bathing, plunging into; आनन्दमन्दममृतप्लवनादिवाभूत् [[Māl. 1. 19.]] 
__3 Flying. 
__4 Jumping, leaping. 
__5 A great flood, deluge. 
__6 A declivity. 
__7 One of a horse's paces (capering).
a. [प्लवेन तरति ठन्] Taking over in a boat, a ferry-man.

[प्लु-घञ्] 
__1 Flowing over. 
__2 Jumping, leaping, क्वचिच्च दर्दुरप्लावैर्विविधैरुपहासकैः [[Bhāg. 10. 18. 15.]] 
__3 Filling to, overflowing. 
__4 Straining a liquid (to remove impurities &c.); भस्माद्भिः कांस्यलोहानां शुद्धिः प्लावो द्रवस्य तु [[Y. 1. 190]] (see [[Mit.]] thereon). 
__5 Submersion.

[प्लु णिच् ल्युट्] 
__1 Bathing, ablution. 
__2 Overflowing, flooding, inundating. 
__3 A flood, deluge. 
__4 Prolation (of a vowel).
a. One who causes to swim or cross (a boatsman); गुरुः प्लाबयिता तस्य ज्ञानं प्लब इहोच्यते [[Mb. 12. 326. 23.]]

p. p. [प्लु णिच् क्त] 
__1 Made to swim, float, or overflow. 
__2 Deluged, inundated, overflowed. 
__3 Moistened, wetted, sprinkled; गलन्मधुप्लाबितदूरबर्त्मनि [[Śi. 12. 26]]; विबिक्तेऽस्मिन्नगे भूयः प्लाविते जह्नुकन्यया [[Ki. 11. 36.]] 
__4 Covered with, smeared. 
__5 Lengthened, prolated (as a vowel); प्लाबितेन स्बरेणोच्चैराजुहावाकुलेन्द्रियः [[Bhāg. 6. 1. 29.]] 
-तम् 
__1 Inundation, flood. 
__2 A song in which the vowels are prolated.

a. [प्लु-णिनि] 
__1 Spreading over, deluging, overflowing. 
__2 Promulgating. -m. A bird.
